title: Ain't I a Woman?: evidence and inference
prompt: Answer each question in two or three sentences. Quote the speech to support your answer.

items.prompt: What can you infer about how the audience treated Truth from what she says about the man who spoke before her? Quote the line that supports your inference.
Which detail from her own life is the strongest support for her claim? Explain why it is stronger than another detail she gives.
Truth answers the argument about intellect and the argument about Christ. Which answer is more convincing, and what evidence makes it so?
